Ranking options

0% = prioritize nearest visual match; 80% = stronger preference for familiar names. This is a heuristic ranking weight, NOT a probability or measured usage frequency.

2. Search results

5 most likely color words · select one

Choose a method to begin. Word mode starts with “tan”.

Method and limitations: ColorThief-style median-cut extracts a 3-color palette from the selected crop; it is not the official ColorThief package. RGB → CIELAB (D65) and CIEDE2000 compare colors. Naming uses a curated vocabulary and heuristic common-name weights (not measured frequency). Text matching uses local character-ngram vector embeddings and a small manually defined synonym vocabulary, not a neural pretrained model. Image processing happens locally in your browser; no server or internet required. A clicked pixel may reflect glare, shadows, or lighting rather than true glaze color.
